# Prerequisites

Before you begin the configuration process, ensure you have the following requirements met:

- Brand Information: Valid, correct, and legal information regarding your brand.
- Logo Image: An image file in PNG or JPG format (224x224 px, max 50KB).
- Banner Image: An image file in PNG or JPG format (1440x448 px, max 200KB).
- Testing Device: A mobile device that supports RCS messaging for verification purposes.

# Configuration steps

Follow these steps to create your RCS App:

1. Navigate to the **Apps** dashboard.
2. Click the **Configure new app** dropdown menu and select **RCS**.
3. In **Application** details tab, customize the appearance and contact information for your business and provide the details:
   1. For the details, refer to the table for [RCS onboarding guidelines](https://help.webexconnect.io/v6.17.0/docs/rcs-onboarding-guidelines) and fill the required sections (rows until Test Numbers provide details for sections for Application). 
   2. Once you have given the relevant details click **Submit** and the Application will be moved to **Set up in progress** status. After the support team approves it you can move to submit Launch Questionnaire. After the application is approved, you can set Launch Questionnaire.
4. Click **Launch Questionnaire.** This defines how users will interact with your agent. Provide the details for the questionnaire:
   1. Refer to the table for [RCS onboarding guidelines](https://help.webexconnect.io/v6.17.0/docs/rcs-onboarding-guidelines) and fill the required sections (follow the rows after Test Numbers to provide details for launch questionnaire).
   2. Click **Next** to set up add the mobile carriers that will support your RCS App.
   3. Click **Add carriers**.
5. Click **Submit**.

After adding the necessary carriers, finalize the submission. You will receive a confirmation that your RCS App has been successfully submitted for processing.
